conditions: Publishers must obtain consent from their users to process personal data
Apps under the Google Play Designed for Families policy MUST set the COPPA privacy flag to true
effects: Sets user consent data for privacy laws, which affect the way ads are displayed based on user consent

conditions: For GDPR: User consents to behavioral targeting
For CCPA: User consents to sale of personal information
For COPPA: App is child-directed, and COPPA restrictions apply
effects: Enables display of Behavioral and Contextual Ads for GDPR and CCPA consented users
Restricts transmitting the android advertising identifier for COPPA compliant apps

conditions: For GDPR: User does not consent to behavioral targeting
For CCPA: User opts out of the sale of personal information
For COPPA: App is not child-directed, and COPPA restrictions do not apply
effects: Only Contextual Ads will be displayed for GDPR and CCPA non-consented users
Allows for Behavioral and Contextual Ads if COPPA does not apply

conditions: Custom consent is provided by the publisher, compliant with IAB’s U.S. Privacy String
effects: Allows for custom consent information beyond predefined GDPR and CCPA values

conditions: Clearing consent is applicable when there are changes in user consent status or if the user requests it
effects: Removes previously stored consent data related to GDPR, CCPA, and COPPA

conditions: The specified privacy standard has previously been set for user consent
effects: Clears the data use consent related to the specified privacy standard
